title: Everyday Phrases — Adopting a Shelter Dog
title_quote: Excuse me, is this the shelter?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🐶 實用領養毛小孩必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Adopting a Shelter Dog
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「領養狗」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是動物收容所：先在籠舍前挑一隻想認識的狗、問牠的性格與健康狀況、填表面談並付領養費，最後一起準備帶牠回家的第一晚——睡墊、牽繩、第一頓飯。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。常用句型包含問可不可以看看牠、問牠幾歲、會不會咬人、要準備什麼。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Adopting a Shelter Dog' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene is an animal shelter: choosing a dog to meet, asking about its temperament and health, filling in the form and paying the adoption fee, and then getting ready for the first night at home — a bed, a leash, and the first meal. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is this the shelter?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，這裡是收容所嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please come in and look.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We want to adopt a dog.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many dogs live here now?
dialogue.zh: 現在這裡住著多少隻狗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 今天大約有四十隻在等家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are they all small and friendly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most of them are very friendly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we walk down this aisle?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以沿著這排籠子走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That grey dog keeps looking at us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɡreɪ dɔɡ kips ˈlʊkɪŋ æt ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 那隻灰色的狗一直在看我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we meet this one first?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以先認識這一隻嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, her name is Daisy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How old is this small one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What breed is she, do you know?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt brid ɪz ʃi du ju noʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 她是什麼品種，你知道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's a mixed breed, mostly beagle.
dialogue.zh: 她是混種，主要是米格魯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why was she sent to you?
dialogue.zh: 她為什麼被送到你們這裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her owner moved to another country.
dialogue.zh: 她的主人搬到別的國家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 她已經會定點上廁所了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she get along with cats?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What was her name again, sorry?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，她叫什麼名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I pet her through the gate?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ pɛt hər θru ðə ɡeɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以隔著籠子摸她嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以，但要慢慢來、輕輕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She is wagging her tail now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we take her to the yard?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi teɪk hər tu ðə jɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以帶她到院子裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will get her leash.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a quiet room here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡有安靜一點的房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long has she been here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she bark at other dogs?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I see her health record?
dialogue.zh: 我可以看她的健康紀錄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she always eat the same food?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ʃi ˈɔlweɪz it ðə seɪm fud?/
dialogue.zh: 她總是吃同一種飼料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we bring our kids later?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以晚點帶小孩來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can we take her home?
dialogue.zh: 我們什麼時候可以帶她回家？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 等我們看過你們的表格之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will come back tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, ask for me at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt æsk fər mi æt ðə dɛsk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This white puppy is very playful.
dialogue.zh: 這隻白色的小狗很愛玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is only four months old.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He jumps on everyone who passes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are training him to sit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he chew on furniture at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz hi tʃu ɑn ˈfərnɪtʃər æt hoʊm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How big will he get later?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds a little too big.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then look at the smaller ones.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The small grey one is hiding.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is shy with new people.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I sit here and wait?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She came out and sniffed my hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi keɪm aʊt ænd snɪft maɪ hænd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now she is licking my fingers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happened to her front leg?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it still hurt her now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Were her shots updated this year?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can she sleep inside the house?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she need a lot of exercise?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ʃi nid ə lɑt əv ˈɛksərsaɪz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is she afraid of loud noises?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we feed her now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 任何好的乾狗糧都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does she eat daily?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About one cup, twice a day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we walk her outside now?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在可以帶她出去走走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She is running around the grass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she come when you call?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, Daisy, come get this treat!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is coming right to you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She sat down next to my feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sæt daʊn nɛkst tu maɪ fit./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We still need to ask my husband.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi stɪl nid tu æsk maɪ ˈhʌzbənd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take a photo and call him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do you close tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will talk it over at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl tɔk ɪt ˈoʊvər æt hoʊm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, take all the time you need.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr teɪk ɔl ðə taɪm ju nid./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, we are back again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome back, Daisy is still here.
dialogue.zh: 歡迎回來，Daisy 還在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We have a few more questions.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has she had all her vaccines?
dialogue.zh: 她所有的疫苗都打了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, all her shots are done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can she live with small kids?
dialogue.zh: 她可以跟小孩一起住嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many walks does she need?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has she had a full checkup yet?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæz ʃi hæd ə fʊl ˈtʃɛkʌp jɛt?/
dialogue.zh: 她做過完整健康檢查了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she have any health problems?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check her records now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在查一下她的紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is something wrong with her file?
dialogue.zh: 她的資料有什麼問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do you need two more days?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ du ju nid tu mɔr deɪz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The vet report is not ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We really want to take her.
dialogue.zh: 我們真的很想帶她回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is one more problem, actually.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What kind of problem is it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 還有另一個家庭也想要她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they already put a hold?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那真是令人失望的消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am truly sorry about it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When will they decide for sure?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 他們明天會打電話給我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we should look at other dogs.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi ʃʊd lʊk æt ˈʌðər dɔɡz./
dialogue.zh: 那我們應該看看別的狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there another calm small dog?
dialogue.zh: 還有另一隻安靜的小型狗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How old is Maggie, may I ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ oʊld ɪz ˈmæɡi meɪ aɪ æsk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is almost three years old.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is she good with small children?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She loves to play with kids.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she bark when left alone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is quiet in the house.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are her vaccines all finished too?
dialogue.zh: 她的疫苗也都打完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，她還需要一針。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we meet Maggie this afternoon?
dialogue.zh: 我們下午可以見見瑪姬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, she is in cage twelve.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is Maggie like with other dogs?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ˈmæɡi laɪk wɪð ˈʌðər dɔɡz?/
dialogue.zh: 瑪姬跟其她狗相處得如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She shares a kennel with two.
dialogue.zh: 她跟兩隻狗同住一個籠子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we walk her in the yard?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi wɔk hɜr ɪn ðə jɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以帶她到院子走走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me get her leash first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maggie is pulling on the leash.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 她只是需要多一點訓練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She sits when I say sit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she sit for a treat?
dialogue.zh: 給她零食她就會坐下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maggie is rolling in the grass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could she sleep in our bedroom?
dialogue.zh: 她可以睡在我們臥室嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does she weigh now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When we travel, who keeps her?
dialogue.zh: 我們出遠門時，誰照顧她？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們可以讓她住在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you offer a trial week?
dialogue.zh: 你們有試養一週的方案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds perfect for our family.
dialogue.zh: 那對我們家來說太完美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很多家庭都用得很開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does the trial week work?
dialogue.zh: 試養一週是怎麼進行的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The children might get scared, though.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can always bring her back.
dialogue.zh: 你隨時可以把她帶回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me about the adoption fee.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the fee cover her vaccines?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can we start the paperwork?
dialogue.zh: 我們什麼時候可以開始辦手續？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 如果你願意，現在就可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we still wait for Daisy?
dialogue.zh: 我們還要繼續等 Daisy 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think Maggie is our dog.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得瑪姬就是我們的狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's fill out the form now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is a pen and clipboard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please tell us what you need.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you visit our home first?
dialogue.zh: 你們會先到我們家拜訪嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the trial week?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will pick her up Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for all your help.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Goodbye, Daisy, we will miss you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will find a good home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maggie, you are coming home tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 瑪姬，你明天就要回家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I fill this form now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在可以填這張表嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which line do I start with?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I write my old address?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不用，只寫你現在住的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does the review take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，我們這週會打給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is anyone at home against it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is anyone home during the day?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我鄰居中午會來看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I work from home most days.
dialogue.zh: 我大部分時間在家工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you owned a dog before?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a small one growing up.
dialogue.zh: 有，小時候養過一隻小型犬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do you want this one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 她看起來很冷靜又溫和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我今天就要全部付清嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，現金或刷卡都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can I take her home?
dialogue.zh: 我什麼時候可以帶她回家？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 她還需要打另一劑疫苗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a travel crate?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I buy food before then?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which bowls should I pick up?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we meet her one more time?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi mit hər wʌn mɔr taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以再見她一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she walk well on a leash?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ʃi wɔk wɛl ɑn ə liʃ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 大致上可以，她會拉一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 還有什麼我該知道的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She hates loud noises at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which paper do I sign first?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need my ID card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，還要一個電話號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 房東的同意書這樣夠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 簡短的電子郵件就可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you hold her until Saturday?
dialogue.zh: 你們可以幫我留到週六嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we hold for three days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time should I come Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring a friend along?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her leash is in my bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the bowls come with her?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I buy cheap bowls?
dialogue.zh: 哪裡可以買到便宜的碗？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we really need a soft bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ˈrɪəli nid ə sɔft bɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 我們真的需要軟的睡墊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she sleeps on soft things.
dialogue.zh: 是的，她都睡在軟的東西上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How big should the bed be?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which food did she eat here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much should I feed her?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I change her food later?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a tag for her collar?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə tæɡ fɔr hər ˈkɑlər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有，我們這裡可以印一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What name goes on the tag?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the chip hurt when inserted?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I get the chip number?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I walk her outside now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在可以帶她出去走走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if she hides from me?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I buy a few toys too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ baɪ ə fju tɔɪz tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get the fee back?
dialogue.zh: 這筆費用可以拿回來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but it covers her shots.
dialogue.zh: 不行，但它包含她的疫苗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 瑪姬現在在聞每個角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this spot okay for her bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs spɑt oʊˈkeɪ fɔr hər bɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 這個位置給她的睡墊可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pull her out gently?
dialogue.zh: 我可以輕輕把她拉出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her tail is tucked down low.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will she stay scared?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half a cup seems too little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She ate it in one minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is her water bowl still full?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we going to bed now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if she cries at midnight?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can she sleep on my bed?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not tonight, she needs her own.
dialogue.zh: 今晚不行，她需要自己的床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll sleep on the floor too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We made it through night one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning came and she's still here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she wake up at all?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我輕聲說話，她就安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her tail is wagging this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we try a short walk?
dialogue.zh: 我們要不要試著短暫散步？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 她在每棵樹前都停下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A big dog barked at us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back home, she drank a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She feels safe, so she relaxes.
dialogue.zh: 她覺得安全，所以就放鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I still need to stay home?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ stɪl nid tu steɪ hoʊm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today yes, tomorrow you can work.
dialogue.zh: 今天要，明天你可以去上班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything I should leave for her?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I close the bedroom door?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那是她建立感情的方式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to buy her own blanket.
dialogue.zh: 該幫她買條自己的毯子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My neighbor wants to meet her.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly, one person at a time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那很正常，她在守護地盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I stop the barking?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 傍晚到了，她打了個哈欠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's tired from her big day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She walked to her bed alone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 她八點前就閉上眼睛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 她終於覺得這裡是家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow we'll try the park again.
dialogue.zh: 明天我們再試一次公園。

issues.note: 212-221 的「家訪/資格訪談」段：提問落在 a 軌、申請人個人作答落在 b 軌，與前後段落（200-211、222-229：a=領養人、b=收容所）相比聲位互換；216『I work from home most days.』是全篇少見落在提問軌的陳述句，217『That's great for a dog.』才是收容所回應。每一組本身仍貼合（212/213、214/215、216/217、218/219 都是問-答或陳述-回應），事實面也沒有衝突，故判 warning 而非 error：若成品是固定兩把聲音，此 10 行會短暫換角。

256『Could you hold her until Monday?』/257『Yes, we hold for three days.』與 231『Saturday morning, after her shot.』、234『What should I bring Saturday?』、258-259『What time should I come Saturday?』/『Ten in the morning works.』並置，讀起來像殘留的第二個取狗方案。非直接事實矛盾（週六到週一為 2 天，仍在 3 天保留期內），但同一段先問保留到週一、緊接又問週六幾點到，聽感略跳。
212『Is anyone at home against it?』與 214『Is anyone home during the day?』相鄰兩句同以 Is anyone 開頭，是全篇唯一一次相鄰開頭詞完全重複（內容不同，僅屬變化度小瑕）。
222/223 重新問答費用（174/175 已答過），200-205 的填表節奏也與 184-187 重疊。屬後半自成一景的重述，資訊一致（皆 two hundred dollars），非矛盾。
285『Between her shoulder blades.』與 251『the adoption contract』是全篇詞彙上最偏 B1 的兩處，但仍具體可理解、非超綱硬詞；其餘全篇為自然口語。
313『Give her half a cup.』與 275『One cup, morning and night.』表面份量不一致，但 315『Too much makes her sick.』就在下一句解釋為第一晚少量，屬可接受的刻意設計。
純文字視圖沒有 phonetic 欄位，本輪無法用肉眼複核『9 處陳舊音標已逐詞對齊』這項；僅能依機器證據（ipa_vote 0 條 SUSPECT、ipa_shape/ipa_tokens 全 0）判為已清，此為本報告唯一未能獨立目視驗證的項目。

review.summary_zh: round2 所列 9 類問題在文字視圖上逐條核對皆已落實修正，全篇名字、性別、毛色、年齡、體重、籠號、費用與取狗時間無事實衝突，A2 口語與結尾收束良好，據此通過。僅餘三處非 error 級小瑕：212-221 訪談段兩把聲音的聲位互換（216 陳述句落在提問軌）、256-257 的「保留到週一」與週六取狗並置、313 半杯與 275 一杯兩餐的份量落差（已由 315 就地解釋）。
